description:
[PUBLISHES to social accounts · `publish` scope] Books every generated draft of a builder campaign into the campaign's own posting queue, each pinned to its slot time — the posts GO LIVE on the platforms at those times unless the brief requires review. Booking again skips drafts already booked; drafts too close to their time are returned in `skippedTooSoon`. Needs `publish`; Agency plan. Confirm with the user first.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/campaigns/builder/{id}/book.)

brandId.description: Brand to act in. A brand-bound key acts in its own brand (another brandId is 403); an account-wide key defaults to the owner's active brand.

name: book_campaign
title: Book a campaign's drafts
